body:
🌲**Welcome to MapleSMP!** 🍁  

Your next adventure starts here…

Dive into a fresh and friendly **survival experience** where community comes first. At MapleSMP, you’re not just another player - you’re part of a growing world full of creativity, exploration, and fun!

✨ **What we offer:**

* Pure Survival with exciting features
* Friendly & active community
* Custom events and challenges
* Player-driven economy
* Stunning builds and endless possibilities

🏡 Build your dream base, team up with friends, or go solo and conquer the world — the choice is yours.

💬 Join today and become part of the MapleSMP story!
    [Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/minecraftmaplesmp)

👉 **MapleSMP — Where every block matters.**
